review.verdict: Personal best on Vaelastrasz and second on Chromaggus

fix.text: Active 47% of the kill, 16 seconds without a swing from 0:30.

review.verdict: 22 afflictions cleansed on Chromaggus, low healing share

review.verdict: Died in the Firemaw wipe and last of the warlocks

good.title: Broodlord 71

review.verdict: Main tank on Vaelastrasz, then the second death of the Firemaw wipe
review.summary: You took every hit and Flame Breath on Vaelastrasz (86) and tanked Broodlord, Ebonroc and Chromaggus. On the Firemaw wipe, with the Technicians loose, bombs killed you at 0:18, the second death, and you played the rest without world buffs. Nefarian (69) and the thin consumables are the notes.

good.title: Vaelastrasz tank

fix.title: Consumables

50613.text: Killed by loose Technicians' bombs at 0:18 in the wipe.

review.verdict: Personal bests, but the lowest mage most of the night

fix.title: Damage
fix.text: Last mage on seven of eight bosses.

review.verdict: Firemaw 94 and Frenzy duty, on Mongoose alone
review.summary: Your fourth raid with us: Firemaw 94 (top hunter), 2 Tranquilizing Shots on Flamegor, no deaths. Ebonroc (31, last of the DPS) and Vaelastrasz (48) were low, and Mongoose was your only consumable.

review.verdict: Chromaggus 95 and Nefarian 92, died in the Firemaw wipe
review.summary: Chromaggus 95 (equal to your best) and Nefarian 92 (another) were strong. You died in the Firemaw wipe after the body pull (8th of 12), not your doing. Vaelastrasz 18 was the low point.

review.verdict: Parsed 96 on average and still managed to be the first corpse of three different pulls
review.summary: The parses were excellent: Nefarian 99, Broodlord and Ebonroc 98, Chromaggus 97, a 96 average against your usual 77. It's a shame you spent so much of the raid dead. You body pulled Firemaw while techie-tanking, died ten seconds into that pull and set off a wipe that killed twelve. Then you went back to the Technicians, took more of their hits than anyone (20) and died to a Bomb, first death of that pull. Then a Death Talon Overseer hit you twice and you were dead five seconds into the next pull, first again. A 99 parser who can't stay alive on trash.

good.title: Nefarian 99
good.text: Third highest damage in the raid on Nefarian, with Broodlord 98, Ebonroc 98 and Chromaggus 97 next to it.

good.title: Personal bests
good.text: Flamegor 95 (best before: 88), Chromaggus 97 (equal to your best), Vaelastrasz 88 (usual 70).

good.title: Consumables
good.text: Supreme Power, Greater Arcane and Mageblood on every pull, 5.1 buffs a pull against 3.7 for the other DPS. Shame about the part where you kept dying with them on.

fix.title: Firemaw: you pulled it
fix.text: Every Technician attack in the 20 seconds before the pull went to you, and you were 19 yards from Firemaw, 13 yards closer than anyone else. He woke up, you died at 0:10, and with nobody holding the Technicians, twelve people died. Techie-tank in the open, nowhere near a sleeping dragon.

fix.title: Then the Technicians killed you again
fix.text: At 25:44 the Technicians hit you 20 times, more than anyone in the raid, and a Bomb killed you: first death of the pull. Same job, same result, five minutes later.

fix.title: And then a Death Talon Overseer
fix.text: At 33:16 an Overseer hit you twice and you were dead 4.9 seconds into the pull, the first death again. Three pulls, three times first to die.

50613.text: Body pulled him while techie-tanking, first death of the wipe at 0:10.

review.verdict: The only Veil of Shadow removal, little healing
review.summary: You removed the only Veil of Shadow on Nefarian and 10 afflictions on Chromaggus, but were last of the healers on Flamegor and Nefarian and died in the Firemaw wipe (to the whelps).

fix.title: Healing
fix.text: Last healer on Flamegor and Nefarian, 2 to 5% elsewhere.

fix.title: Razorgore

review.summary: No deaths, an 84 average, Ebonroc 95 and Firemaw 93, and 2 Tranquilizing Shots each on Flamegor and Chromaggus. Consumables were thin: Mongoose, some Zanza, food twice.

review.verdict: Annoyingly good: 92 or better on six of eight bosses, and nothing to blame you for except your shopping
review.summary: You asked to be roasted and then went and played a BWL with almost nothing to roast. Broodlord and Chromaggus 98, Firemaw and Nefarian 95, a 93 average, no deaths, alive through the Firemaw wipe while twelve people around you faceplanted. So we'll have to go after your bags: no flask, no Zanza, and a cat that parses 98 on Chromaggus while drinking Winterfall Firewater like it's a personality.

good.title: Consistent at the top
good.text: Broodlord 98, Chromaggus 98, Firemaw 95, Nefarian 95, Flamegor 94, Ebonroc 92. Vaelastrasz 87 is well over your usual 76 there.

good.title: Survived the Firemaw wipe

good.title: Faerie Fire

fix.title: Consumables of a man who thinks he's too good for a flask
fix.text: Mongoose, Juju Power and food on every pull, Firewater on five of seven, and then nothing. No flask, no Zanza. You parsed 98 without them, which is exactly the problem: imagine the insufferable logs with them.

fix.title: Chromaggus breath
fix.text: One Incinerate (3,250). Only four people in the raid got hit by a breath at all.

fix.title: Razorgore
fix.text: 82, your worst of the night and seven under your usual. Out-parsed by your own average.
